rows.note: Use this for sustained or probing questioning, especially by the police or another authority.

example.english: The police kept him under interrogation for several hours to get to the bottom of the matter.

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a question that someone puts forward.

example.english: If you have a question, just ask directly; there’s no need for an interrogation.

rows.note: Use this for an inquiry or request for information rather than a single question.

example.english: If you want a timetable inquiry, just call this number; you don’t need to come in for an interrogation.
